name: ArtifactGeneratorAgent
description: Bridges comprehension output to execution-ready YAML artifacts. Registered twice: 'artifact_generator_intents' (mode=intents: business_scenarios.json -> deduplicated, DOM-grounded intents.yaml) and 'artifact_generator_testcases' (mode=testcases: intents.yaml + test_data.json -> enriched intents, test_cases.yaml, test_suite.yaml). Not a step in any shipped workflow; kept for standalone/legacy runs.

inputs.name: project_name
inputs.description: Project folder under application_assets/projects (falls back to message, then 'project')

inputs.name: project_state
inputs.description: Persistent project state — existing test cases used as a dedup hint

inputs.name: module_filter
inputs.description: Restrict DOM grounding to one module

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: success | failed (skipped=true when every scenario is already covered)

outputs.name: intents_generated
outputs.description: intents mode — new intents written to intents.yaml

outputs.name: intents_total
outputs.description: intents mode — intents in intents.yaml after the merge

outputs.name: dom_grounded
outputs.description: intents mode — intents matched to a DOM locator

outputs.name: test_cases_generated
outputs.description: testcases mode — test cases produced by the LLM

outputs.name: test_cases_valid
outputs.description: testcases mode — test cases that passed validation

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: Paths of the written YAML artifacts
